observations: A large rounded head shape fills the center, outlined in white and light blue, with a row of small red triangles crowning the top against a yellow background patch.
Two eye-like forms sit asymmetrically: the left marked by a bold red X over a crosshatch circle, the right by a smaller red cross, both set against yellow and white fills.
Teal horizontal bars stack along the right edge, overlaid with red and white zigzag lines, while lime-green diagonal strokes and vertical brown-yellow stripes fill the left margin.
reading: The head looms off-center, its brown and orange fill broken by competing marks—crossed-out eyes, bared white teeth, blue dashes running down one cheek. Surrounding bands of teal, lime, and vertical stripes press inward, giving the composition a boxed-in quality. The red triangle crown reads as both ornament and warning. The overall effect can feel confrontational, even comic, as if caught between a grin and a grimace.
contextAngle: In the owned rawblocks subset, this work sits between "nnxyz rawblocks #3" and "nnxyz rawblocks #5" by title number. Compared to #3's smooth, rounded head and soft teal background, #4 packs the surface with competing line systems and a much denser color range.

connections.reason: Both share a crowned head with small triangles along the top, but #3's single smooth yellow mass contrasts sharply with #4's fractured, heavily layered surface.
The crossed-out eye motif and exposed-teeth mouth in #4 closely echo the red-gridded eyes and long vertical teeth in this nifty faces work.

lookingQuestion: How do the blue dashes running down the right side of the face change your reading of the expression compared to the red marks on the left?
ambiguities: Small marks near the lower left may be a signature or additional drawn elements; their role is unclear at this scale.
Whether the white zigzag line crossing the full width is part of the head or the background cannot be determined from the image alone.
